name: Hey Duggee
description: Animated preschool series about a clubhouse that is run by a big dog called Duggee.

videos.title: Top of the Pups: The Kick Song
Top of the Pups: The Stick Song
videos.overview: Sing along to the Stick Song - you won’t get it out of your head!

videos.title: Top of the Pups: The Whistling Song
Top of the Pups: The Dancing Bug Song
Top of the Pups: The Omelette Song
videos.overview: Watch the Squirrels work out with the chickens to Hennie's funky tunes!

videos.title: Top of the Pups: The Raindance Song
videos.overview: Duggee teaches the Squirrels the best rain dance ever.

videos.title: Top of the Pups: The Singing Song
Top of the Pups: The Train Song
Top of the Pups: The Toothbrush Song
Top of the Pups: The A Cappella Song
Top of the Pups: The Christmas song
videos.overview: Isn’t it time for… Jingle Bells! We’ve got a festive Hey Duggee tune for you and your little Squirrels to sing and dance along to.

videos.title: Top of the Pups : Bath Time
videos.overview: Mrs Weaver sings a song about how much fun bath time is.

videos.title: Top of the Pups: Wheels on the Bus
videos.overview: The Squirrels go on a bus ride with Duggee as they sing 'Wheels on the Bus'.

videos.title: Top of the Pups: Spooky
videos.overview: Isn't it time for... Spooooky! We've got a Hey Duggee Halloween Song for you and your little Squirrels to dance along to!

videos.title: The Tinsel Badge
videos.overview: It's nearly Christmas and Duggee is wrapping presents to go under the tree.

videos.title: The Drawing Badge
videos.overview: It is raining, so Duggee and the Squirrels stay indoors to do some drawing. Can anybody guess what Duggee has drawn?

videos.title: The Cake Badge
videos.overview: Happy finds a cake lying around in the field and decides to eat it. But whose cake is it?

videos.title: The Hair Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is having a bad hair day. Can the Squirrels help him at all?

videos.title: The Summer Holiday Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are out tobogganing with Duggee when they spot a migrating bird falling from the sky.

videos.title: The Rescue Badge
videos.overview: Enid the cat is stuck up the tree. How will Duggee and the Squirrels get her down?

videos.title: The Super Squirrel Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels decide they want to be superheroes. Is there anyone that needs their help?

videos.title: The Jam Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is making jam, but Naughty Monkey steals all of Duggee's fruit. Can the Squirrels help catch him?

videos.title: The Treasure Hunt Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels find a treasure map inside Duggee's big shiny ruby. X marks the spot!

videos.title: The Scarecrow Badge
videos.overview: The birds keep eating Duggee's grain, so the Squirrels build an enormous scarecrow to frighten them away.

videos.title: The Funny Face Badge
videos.overview: Whooooo the shamanistic owl looks a bit down. How can the Squirrels cheer her up?

videos.title: The Bouncing Badge
videos.overview: It is Tag's birthday and Duggee has put up a bouncy castle to celebrate, but a big, gloomy cloud falls asleep right over it.

videos.title: The Leaf Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are on a woodland walk to help Duggee look for a very special leaf when they hear the strangest noise.

videos.title: The Omelette Badge
videos.overview: Duggee decides to make an omelette, but there are no eggs. Where are all the chickens, and why aren't they laying any eggs?

videos.title: The Food Growing Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is sowing seeds. The Squirrels ask if they can grow something too. One of the Squirrels is in for an enormous surprise.

videos.title: The Paddling Pool Badge
videos.overview: It's a scorcher of a day, but luckily Duggee has a big paddling pool. However, he needs help to blow it up and fill it with water.

videos.title: The Paper Boat Badge
videos.overview: Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make a paper boat out of newspaper, and they help some ants get to the other side of the pond.

videos.title: The Castle Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels hear an echoing voice coming from the top of a castle's spooky tower. Someone is calling them - but who is it?

videos.title: The Show and Tell Badge
videos.overview: Duggee has something really interesting to show at the clubhouse. Can the Squirrels find some other interesting things to share?

videos.title: The Rocking Horse Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is tidying when he comes across his old rocking horse, Bucky. The Squirrels help mend Bucky and in return get to ride him.

videos.title: The Get Well Soon Badge
videos.overview: Norrie is sick. Can the Squirrels think of something to cheer her up? Happy suggests a get well soon card.

videos.title: The Hiccup Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels meet a little worm who has swallowed a bit too much earth and has got the hiccups.

videos.title: The Maze Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels work hard to help Duggee clean his workshop but when they finish they can't find him. Oh! They've built a maze around him.

videos.title: The Raindance Badge
videos.overview: It's a very hot day and Duggee's flowers are looking very sad, so Duggee teaches the Squirrels the best rain dance ever.

videos.title: The Acorn Badge
videos.overview: Norrie is sad when she sees a falling leaf, until she learns that some trees shed their leaves in autumn. But ouch! What has Roly found?

videos.title: The Balloon Badge
videos.overview: Something unexpected happens when Duggee gives Tino the mouse some birthday balloons.

videos.title: The Hide-and-Seek Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels play hide-and-seek. The Squirrels have hidden in good places, but Duggee finds them all - except Roly.

videos.title: The Sheep Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are playing with their toys when they notice that there is a sheep in the clubhouse.

videos.title: The Spider Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are playing in the clubhouse when Norrie discovers a spider in the dressing-up box.

videos.title: The We Love Animals Badge
videos.overview: When Duggee strokes Enid the cat, the Squirrels want to find animals they can stroke too.

videos.title: The Snowman Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels play outside in the snow and decide to build a jolly looking snowman, but the punky penguins poke fun at it.

videos.title: The Decorating Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is painting the clubhouse. The Squirrels ask if they can help too, but they have some different colours in mind.

videos.title: The Tidy Up Badge
videos.overview: It is time for a Squirrel clubhouse spring clean. Duggee is dusting when the doorbell goes and a big package arrives for him.

videos.title: The Circus Badge
videos.overview: The circus has come to town and the Squirrels are very excited until they see that it is a flea circus. It is so tiny!

videos.title: The Egg Badge
videos.overview: One of the chickens is laying her eggs. One chick, two chicks and OOPS! Oh dear, the third chick is a little bit stuck.

videos.title: The Puppy Badge
videos.overview: Duggee's nephew Dugley comes to stay. He is one cute puppy, but he looks like he could cause chaos in the clubhouse. And what's that terrible smell?

videos.title: The Cardboard Box Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels dress up as brave knights in cardboard costumes, but when they go to their castle, they find it already occupied.

videos.title: The Caterpillar Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are helping Duggee in the garden when Tag meets a caterpillar, who eats and eats, getting bigger and bigger.

videos.title: The Sandcastle Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels do such a good job making sandcastles that they are asked to help the crabs build a new home.

videos.title: The Football Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels decide to play football, but the Squirrels have never played it before. How will they ever score a goal?

videos.title: The Puppet Show Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels had a great adventure and want to tell everyone. What better way to tell a story than a puppet show?

videos.title: The Birdwatching Badge
videos.overview: Duggee uses his trusty binoculars to do some birdwatching.

videos.title: The Big Parade Badge
videos.overview: The leader of the Big Parade hurts his leg. Can Duggee and the Squirrels help out?

videos.title: The Be Careful Badge
videos.overview: Naughty Monkey falls into a big hole, and Duggee and the Squirrels have to be very careful when they go to help him.

videos.title: The First Aid Badge
videos.overview: When Tag hurts his knee, Duggee patches him up with help from the Squirrels.

videos.title: The Bubble Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels blow bubbles together, but poor old Happy just cannot get it right.

videos.title: The Submarine Badge
videos.overview: It is a day out for Duggee and the Squirrels as they go on an underwater adventure with Betty's dad in his submarine.

videos.title: The Detective Badge
videos.overview: Duggee puts his homemade apple pie on the windowsill to cool down, but then it disappears. Who took it? Can the Squirrels find out?

videos.title: The Sewing Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels are sewing ponchos when they hear a loud sneeze. Someone needs a hanky - what could they use instead?

videos.title: The Surprise Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels have bought Hennie a present for her birthday. But before they surprise her, they need to wrap it up.

videos.title: The Teddy Bear Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels take their teddy bears on a picnic, where they meet a real bear who wants a teddy too so she can join in.

videos.title: The Story Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels tire themselves out with all their activities, so Duggee suggests they take a break and listen to a story.

videos.title: The Making Music Badge
videos.overview: When the Squirrels find Duggee playing saxophone, they want to have a go too. Several pots, balloons, tins, water and tubes later and the squirrels are making music. And boy, are they LOUD.

videos.title: The Whistling Badge
videos.overview: When Egg, the cheeky little chick, goes on the run again, Duggee whistles to get him back. Hang on a minute Duggee, what was that noise? A whistle? The Squirrels want to learn how to whistle.

videos.title: The Shape Badge
videos.overview: It is a lovely day and the Squirrels are playing outside. They are playing the shape game. Working out which shape goes where is quite tricky.

videos.title: The Juice Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is going to make the Squirrels juice from fresh fruit in the garden. Whilst picking the fruit, the Squirrels meet a little bug, full of woes about being too small. The Squirrels think it must be brilliant to be so tiny but the little bug disagrees.

videos.title: The Footprint Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are playing hide and seek but they can't find Happy. Duggee can though - he follows Happy's footprints. The Squirrels follow lots of different footprints that take them to their friend but there is one set they just can't work out.

videos.title: The Fossil Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are digging in the garden when they come across a fossil, so Duggee explains all about fossils and prehistoric times. When the Squirrels go outside, it seems like they've gone right back in time.

videos.title: The Treehouse Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is cleaning the clubhouse so the Squirrels take refuge in the treehouse, but it's getting a little bit cramped these days. Norrie has an idea - maybe they need to add an extension, just like her dad does when she gets new siblings.

videos.title: The Kite Badge
videos.overview: It's a very windy day and the Squirrels want to play outside. What can they do? Duggee knows - he's flying his kite. The Squirrels set about making their own kites to fly.

videos.title: The Tadpole Badge
videos.overview: Duggee has made a beautiful rock pool, a place of calm for all the animals. The Squirrels spot the strangest things - dots with tails, wriggling around. What on earth are they? They are baby frogs - tadpoles. But they don't sound or look like Frog.

videos.title: The Honey Badge
videos.overview: Duggee's made some delicious pancakes, but the clubhouse is out of honey. Time for the bees to get busy.

videos.title: The Pottery Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is having a lovely cup of tea in his favourite cup when Roly surprises him with a very loud PEEK-A-BOO. It is so loud that Duggee jumps and drops his cup which shatters into pieces. Time for a bit of pottery.

videos.title: The Teamwork Badge
videos.overview: A big box is delivered to the Clubhouse and the Squirrels are very excited. What could be inside? Oh! It is a huge box of bits and pieces. Duggee and the Squirrels are going to have to work very hard to put it all together. Time for a bit of teamwork.

videos.title: The Dancing Bug Badge
videos.overview: When a dancing bug lands on Duggee's head, he can't stop dancing. The Squirrels take a close look and see that it's a tiny hillbilly bug with a fiddle. And what's more, he's got a whole band with him - the Hillbilly Bug Band.

videos.title: The Train Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is playing with his train set. The squirrels are curious and want to know all about it. Duggee explains that it is a toy but it works exactly like a real train. Hennie arrives and she has a train too. The squirrels ask if they can play with it. You can't play with it; you can play IN it says Hennie.

videos.title: The Pizza Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels help Duggee try out his new outdoor pizza oven. Duggee makes the bases, then the Squirrels each put on all the toppings they like best. Some of their combinations are... interesting.

videos.title: The Medicine Badge
videos.overview: Duggee's not very well. He's lost his voice. The squirrels want to make him feel better. Duggee tries to tell them that he needs some water but the squirrels don't quite understand, so they ask all the other animals for advice. Does anyone have the answer?

videos.title: The Camping Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels are going camping. They need to find somewhere to pitch their tent but it's not as easy as they thought it would be. They all work together and finally get settled. But Tag realises he can't sleep without his teddy, and Happy would like a glass of water. Suddenly Duggee is up and down and in and out of the tent getting everything the Squirrels need. In fact, Duggee works so hard that he's the first to fall asleep.

videos.title: The Making Friends Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are off for a jamboree to make some new friends, play games and have a picnic. They meet another group of young animals with their very own version of Duggee but everything they do is different - even Roly finds one of them too loud.

videos.title: The River Badge
videos.overview: Duggee has a package that needs delivering right to the other end of the river, a long way from the clubhouse. It looks like the Squirrels are going to have a day out on the boat.

videos.title: The Yoga Badge
videos.overview: It's one of those days. The Squirrels have arrived and they're all a little bit hyped up with bundles of energy. Things are starting to get a bit frantic and Duggee needs to calm them all down.

videos.title: The Collecting Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is cleaning his biscuit tin collection, one of the many things he collects. The Squirrels are inspired to start their own collections. They busy themselves doing the collecting bit, and then display their precious things in the clubhouse.

videos.title: The Shadow Badge
videos.overview: The sun is setting, and the squirrels are sitting on the sofa. They've had a very busy day. Suddenly all the lights go out. There's been a power cut. The squirrels can't see anything. Thank goodness Duggee has torches for everyone.

videos.title: The Theatre Badge
videos.overview: Tino and Eugene are having a disagreement about an amateur dramatic show they want to put on. One wants an all-singing, all-dancing extravaganza, while the other wants a serious drama. Can Duggee and the Squirrels help them get something ready to perform?

videos.title: The Memory Badge
videos.overview: Happy discovers his wobbly tooth has come out, but he's lost it. He's having a problem remembering where he was when it fell out. The Squirrels start to look for it but they can't find the tooth anywhere. Time to think carefully and remember.

videos.title: The Going Slow Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are rushing around, so Duggee shows them how to enjoy things at a slower pace.

videos.title: The Obstacle Course Badge
videos.overview: It's time for the annual animal obstacle course race. The animals need to work together in teams to complete the course. He and the Squirrels form the RED team and the fun begins.

videos.title: The Spooky Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are playing dress up when they hear a ghostly sound and spot a floating sheet. What is going on?

videos.title: The Space Badge
videos.overview: It's winter and it's dark and too cold to play outside. The Squirrels wonder what Duggee is up to, he seems to be looking through a long stick out of the window. What's that, Duggee? Duggee explains that it's a telescope, and he's looking at things far far away in space. The Squirrels are keen to have a go too but first Duggee tells them about the solar system, and in order to help him they must all dress up as planets.

videos.title: The Harvest Badge
videos.overview: It's that beautiful time of the year. The birds are tweeting and all the crops are looking ripe and ready to pick. Duggee is getting ready to harvest them. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.

videos.title: The Colour Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book. The Squirrels want to have a go too. Betty wants to paint a bee and that's yellow. Tag paints a fire truck and that's red, and Happy paints some water blue. But when it's Norrie's turn she can't find the paint colour she wants. Don't worry, Duggee can mix colours together to make different colours.

videos.title: The Stick Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels are preparing to have a campfire. The Squirrels are busy collecting wood when Roly finds a stick with eyes that pop open. And that's not all. This stick can talk too.

videos.title: The Voice Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels start talking to each other in the wrong voices (was that really Betty yelling like Roly? Why is Tag saying 'splash' like Happy?). It's clear something has gone awry. Don't worry, Duggee knows what to do.

videos.title: The Island Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels are doing a bit of sailing, but when they stop at an island for lunch they find their food is missing.

videos.title: The Sleeping Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels have had an exhausting morning playing. After their milk they can have their nap. But Tag can't sleep. Duggee tells Tag how other animals sleep and describes a few tricks they use to get to sleep.

videos.title: The Brave Banana Badge
videos.overview: It's a stormy day, and the Squirrels are scared of lightning. Fortunately, Duggee knows how to help them overcome their fears.

videos.title: The Water Badge
videos.overview: Happy sees a dripping tap, wasting water. The Squirrels think water is limitless, and they explain where they think it comes from.

videos.title: The Traffic Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is taking the Squirrels to the lake, but lots of people have had the same idea and there's a traffic jam.

videos.title: The Dressing Up Badge
videos.overview: It's Enid's birthday. She doesn't like surprises or cakes, so the Squirrels will throw her a dressing up party. But how?

videos.title: The Getting On Badge
videos.overview: Fox, Badger, Mole, Vole and Worm are not getting on. Can Duggee and the Squirrels suggest ways that they can all live peacefully?

videos.title: The Wedding Badge
videos.overview: King Tiger has met his perfect partner and is getting married. It's going to be a royal wedding, and Duggee is invited.

videos.title: The Grandparents Badge
videos.overview: It is Bring your Grandparents to Squirrel Club Day today, and the grandparents cannot wait.

videos.title: The Organising Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels decide it is time to tidy up. Duggee helps them reorganise everything in the clubhouse.

videos.title: The Looking After Badge
videos.overview: Outside the clubhouse, a large crowd has gathered around a hot-air balloon. It seems someone is going on an adventure.

videos.title: The Comedy Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels want to know what makes Duggee laugh, so Duggee shows them his favourite comedy.

videos.title: The Singing Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels go for a lovely walk, and hear some amazing singing in the distance - who could it be?

videos.title: The Playing Badge
videos.overview: Naughty Monkey's cousins come to visit and they're even naughtier than Naughty Monkey.

videos.title: The Party Badge
videos.overview: There's a parcel for Duggee, and it's wrapped up like a present. Maybe it's Duggee's birthday. The Squirrels decide to throw a party.

videos.title: The Tour Guide Badge
videos.overview: Gerbie the snake is on holiday and would like to see all the beautiful sights.

videos.title: The Sailing Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels have a lovely day sailing on the water, when they encounter the Pirate Penguins.

videos.title: The Key Badge
videos.overview: Roly is digging in the garden when his spade suddenly hits something. It's a key. But what does it do?

videos.title: The Fashion Badge
videos.overview: Duggee's uniform is getting old and worn out. It's time he made himself a new outfit.

videos.title: The Glasses Badge
videos.overview: Mole feels sad that he couldn't pursue his childhood dream of being a stunt mole because his vision is so fuzzy. Can Duggee help?

videos.title: The Being Quiet Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels go on an adventure to find a famously shy creature called The Snard who doesn’t like noise.

videos.title: The Duck Badge
videos.overview: The clubhouse is inundated with stray ducklings who think Norrie is their mum, so Duggee and the Squirrels need to do some detective work to reunite them with their real mum.

videos.title: The Tooth Brushing Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels meet a lion with unfortunate breath and teach him a special song to help him learn how to brush his teeth.

videos.title: The Camouflage Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels meet a chameleon called Cosey and learn about how to blend into their surroundings.

videos.title: The Get Indoors Badge
videos.overview: A severe weather warning from Duggee’s barometer leads the Squirrels to round up all the creatures they can find outside and pile into the clubhouse for an impromptu party.

videos.title: The Day Off Badge
videos.overview: It’s Duggee’s day off, but it’s not long before the Squirrels show up to tell him about their adventures on their own days off.

videos.title: The Pen Pal Badge
videos.overview: Duggee arranges for the Squirrels to write to some pen pals, helping them to learn all about life in far away places, and making some new friends in the process.

videos.title: The Big Day Out Badge
videos.overview: Duggee takes the Squirrels and their parents on an exciting mystery trip, where they learn they can make anywhere special.

videos.title: The Tree Badge
videos.overview: Duggee helps the Squirrels learn about all the amazing things trees do for the creatures who live among them.

videos.title: The Cheese Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels go on a mission to contain an outbreak when Roly inadvertently goes on the run with the world’s smelliest cheese.

videos.title: The Radio Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels stumble upon Duggee's old radio equipment and discover that Duggee used to have his own radio show. The Squirrels decide to start their own, earning lots of fans.

videos.title: The Opposites Badge
videos.overview: When Roly does the opposite of what Norrie asks him to do, she struggles to describe what an 'opposite' is. Duggee and some animal friends explain everything.

videos.title: The Breakfast Badge
videos.overview: Tag is feeling grumpy because he didn't eat his breakfast.

videos.title: The Family Photo Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is putting up a picture of himself with his old friends. This inspires the Squirrels to take a photo of their own, but Duggee then spends a long time searching for everyone who should be in it.

videos.title: The Future Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are transported into the future, where they encounter a robot version of Duggee as well as a few other interesting changes to the clubhouse.

videos.title: The Philosophy Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels think about life's big questions, helping Tino the Artistic Mouse escape a crisis of confidence.

videos.title: The Sharing Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels are baking. But if there are six bakers and only one pie, how will they all get to eat? Duggee shows the Squirrels how to divide things up.

videos.title: The History Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are curious about what happened 'a long, long time ago'. So Duggee takes them on a trip through time, where they meet a host of characters from the past.

videos.title: The Art Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels learn about different types of art and what inspires them while preparing their own pieces for Tino the Artistic Mouse's Woodland Biennale.

videos.title: The Crazy Golf Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels practice their golf swing in some interesting conditions in pursuit of the ultimate prize - a round of milkshakes.

videos.title: The Mystery Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels go to a fancy party at King Tiger's house and become embroiled in a mystery when the prized ruby centrepiece disappears from his party crown.

videos.title: The Election Badge
videos.overview: When Eugene unexpectedly drops out of running the summer fair, Duggee and the Squirrels hold an election to choose the best candidate for the job.

videos.title: The Mixtape Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are exploring in the attic when they find an old cassette tape. They decide to make a mixtape for Duggee to remind him of all the happy memories they’ve made while earning their badges.

videos.title: The Taste Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is making a smoothie, and the Squirrels can’t agree on whether it’s delicious or horrible. So they make their own adventurous smoothies using their favourite flavours to discover what taste is.

videos.title: The Biology Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels hop inside the Biology Bus and miniaturise themselves to go on a voyage of discovery inside Enid. Can they find out what’s making her cough?

videos.title: The Puddle Badge
videos.overview: Happy sees a very questionable-looking puddle that he is determined to splash in, much to the horror of Duggee, the other Squirrels and the tiny citizens of Midgetropolis who live inside it.

videos.title: The Game Show Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels have played all of their board games, so Duggee entertains them by putting on a game show, with some help hosting from his good friend Ladybug.

videos.title: The Round Up Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels go on the trail of a lost herd of cattle with Duggee and his old pal Rodeo Horse, who teaches them how to be cowhands.

videos.title: The Favourite Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels learn what a favourite is but have trouble deciding what their own favourite things are. So they make a film asking some of their friends what is special to them to help narrow it down.

videos.title: The Topiary Badge
videos.overview: When the Squirrels see Duggee practising his impressive topiary skills they are keen to try some of their own – and promptly put their new talents into practice in order to tame some very wild woods.

videos.title: The A Cappella Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are inspired to learn how to sing a cappella style after hearing a famous bird quartet singing in a nearby tree.

videos.title: The Christmas Badge
videos.overview: Duggee’s old friend arrives at the Clubhouse, but he has lost his Christmas cheer. He used to love Christmas, but everything seems to be getting bigger, louder and faster, and it's exhausting.

videos.title: The Babysitting Badge
videos.overview: Duggee has a job to do outside the Clubhouse, but who will look after the Squirrels? King Tiger, of course, since he has his babysitting badge. But it’s actually the Squirrels who end up babysitting King Tiger.

videos.title: The Comic Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is reading the Squirrels one of his favourite comics. They are eager to know the ending, but the comic was discontinued. Duggee shows the Squirrels how to create their own ending.

videos.title: The Senses Badge
videos.overview: Roly has lost his best potato, but Duggee finds it using his sense of smell. But what is a sense? Time for the Squirrels to learn about the five senses.

videos.title: The Diplomacy Badge
videos.overview: Betty and Sergeant Ant just want perfection, but no one seems to be listening to their shouting. They need a lesson in diplomacy to learn how to speak in a more sensitive way.

videos.title: The Buddy Badge
videos.overview: Duggee hosts a Buddy Bonanza for Mrs Weaver and the Squirrels, with the aim of finding new buddies with common interests to them.

videos.title: The Bridge Badge
videos.overview: It’s bridge building time. The Squirrels help a quarreling group of Gerbils sort out their longstanding disagreement.

videos.title: The Soap Opera Badge
videos.overview: After breaking the Chickens' TV aerial during the finale of their favourite soap opera, the Squirrels take it upon themselves to recreate the final episode for them. But will their performance impress the grumpy Chickens?

videos.title: The Mythical Creature Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels find a hidden book about mythical creatures. They learn and discover a wide range of mythical creatures, create their own and find out why the book was hidden in the first place.

videos.title: The Counting Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels try the ultimate achievement of counting to 100.

videos.title: The What Happened Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels try and tell us what has just happened but are struggling to retell the story correctly.

videos.title: The Telling Time Badge
videos.overview: John the Crab needs help planning a surprise party for Nigel. It will only work if everyone is on time with the preparations.

videos.title: The Puzzle Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are close to finishing a jigsaw puzzle when the Naughty Mice steal their last piece. To get it back, they must take part in a series of puzzles in an underground adventure set by the Puzzle Mouse.

videos.title: The Action Hero Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels learn about an action hero called Jet Rocket who always saves the day by smashing and crashing things. But there are other ways to save the day.

videos.title: The Training Badge
videos.overview: Duggee struggles to organise the Squirrels in order of height and keeping them focused on the task. Sounds like the Squirrels need some training to improve their concentration.

videos.title: The Reunion Badge
videos.overview: Duggee hosts a reunion for the first ever Squirrels he looked after. But the first ever Squirrels are older now and very similar to the Squirrels' parents. Does that mean that when the Squirrels are bigger, they will become like their parents too?

videos.title: The Board Game Badge
videos.overview: It is a rainy day in the clubhouse which means it’s a perfect day for a board game. Duggee introduces the Squirrels to one of his favourite games, but it might be just a little bit too complex for them.

videos.title: The Direction Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels go out for a walk but can't find a way back to the clubhouse. Through a series of unusual methods, the Squirrels learn all about direction and how to find their way to the clubhouse.

videos.title: The Perfume Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels make their very own perfumes with accompanying advertisements to show how their perfumes are uniquely theirs.

videos.title: The Building Block Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels become architects so they can design, build and bring to life their very own clubhouse.

videos.title: The Walking Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels learn the many ways you can walk with the help of friends and a catchy song.

videos.title: Norrie's First Day
videos.overview: Norrie and her friends reflect on their first meeting and how Norrie enjoyed the peace of the Clubhouse away from her 72 siblings.

videos.title: The Moving Badge
videos.overview: Snail wishes to leave her wet and sploshy house behind and move up in the world to a new home with more space. But first, she needs help from the Squirrels to move all her belongings.

videos.title: Roly's First Day
videos.overview: Roly has always been loud, right? Well, on his first day in the Clubhouse he was rather quiet. Hiding behind his dad, he couldn't even talk to Duggee.

videos.title: The Spot the Difference Badge
videos.overview: Duggee looks different, but what is it? By playing some looking games, the Squirrels learn how best to spot the difference.

videos.title: Happy's First Day
videos.overview: It’s Happy’s first day at the Squirrel Club, and he is so excited. But there’s a surprise for Happy because there was once a time when he didn’t love water as much as he does now.

videos.title: The Library Badge
videos.overview: When the Squirrels realise no-one is visiting Duggee’s library, they have an idea - a mobile library.

videos.title: Tag's First Day
videos.overview: Before Tag arrived at the Clubhouse, he didn’t know the importance of listening. But on Tag’s first day with Duggee, he soon learnt that paying attention can lead to good things.

videos.title: The Hat Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels introduce King Tiger to lots of different hats and explain what they might be good for. But none of them feels right to him.

videos.title: Betty's First Day
videos.overview: The Squirrels are having fun trying out games but are surprised to find out that Betty didn’t always enjoy playing.

videos.title: The Choreography Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels meet Duggee’s old dance crew and learn that he was kicked out because he couldn’t stick to the choreography. The Squirrels are surprised because Duggee is such a good dancer.

videos.title: The Pet Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels meet a scruffelump in the woods, and despite Duggee’s reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

videos.title: The Lost Property Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels lose Tag in the Clubhouse, but to find him they’re going to have to figure out where the lost property room is.

videos.title: The Mountain Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels need to rescue Enid when they see her at the top of the Mighty Sugar Bun Mountain.

videos.title: The Accessory Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels see Duggee accessorising his tie and want to learn how to do it themselves. All of the Squirrels accessorise an item and showcase their goods.

videos.title: The Ambition Badge
videos.overview: Duggee masters his ambition of building a model of the Clubhouse out of sticks. This encourages the Squirrels to think of their own ambitions, and how they can achieve them.

videos.title: The Rainbow Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels see a rainbow for the very first time, but it disappears so quickly. Together they decide to create a rainbow themselves from everything around them.

videos.title: The Dream Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are playing, but they can’t stop thinking about the dreams they had last night. Duggee helps the Squirrels work out what their dreams mean.

videos.title: The Eating Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are having a picnic and notice that the chickens eat differently than they do. Duggee explains all the different ways animals eat.

videos.title: The Delivery Badge
videos.overview: Chipmunk is cycling one day delivering his packages when he hits a rock and his trike falls apart. He has so many packages to deliver - what is he going to do now?

videos.title: The Same Badge
videos.overview: As Peggee and the Hummingbirds journey up the river to deliver a parcel, they have fun spotting and avoiding the wildlife that they meet along the way.

videos.title: The Days of the Week Badge
videos.overview: After finding out that Mr Wobbly is visiting next Monday, the Squirrels impatiently want to know how long that means they need to wait.

videos.title: The Feelings Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels notice that Happy isn’t acting like his normal self, and he’s strangely wearing new trainers. Happy doesn’t know what he’s feeling, and his friends want to help him.

videos.title: The Choir Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels become enchanted when they hear a piece of music from Duggee's choir. They quickly learn what makes a choir.

videos.title: The Listening Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels hear a strange sound that they've not heard before, so they ask Duggee to help identify it.

videos.title: The Wisdom Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels see Duggee reading about wise animals and wish to learn more about what it means to be wise.

videos.title: The Commuting Badge
videos.overview: Norrie is running late to Squirrel Club, so Duggee teaches the squirrels what a commute is – a journey that can take you from home to learn, work or play.

videos.title: The Ball Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are confused when they see Duggee sitting on a ball because they all have their own favourite way of using it, whether it be kicking, throwing or catching.

videos.title: The News Badge
videos.overview: After learning that Duggee is making his yearly batch of blueberry jam, a tradition passed on from his great-aunt, the Squirrels decide to spread the news.

videos.title: The Difficult Badge
videos.overview: As the Squirrels appreciate Norrie's new bike, they discover that she doesn’t know how to ride it. She finds it too difficult.

videos.title: The Cinema Badge
videos.overview: Before the Squirrels attend the cinema for the first time, Duggee teaches them that there are rules they need to follow.

videos.title: The Getting Ready Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are getting ready for the same woodland adventure, but their mornings all look slightly different.

videos.title: The Size Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels learn about atoms, molecules and cells to help understand sizing when they try to sort a line-up of things from smallest to biggest.

videos.title: The Wish Badge
videos.overview: Whilst helping Duggee clean up, the Squirrels come across an old lamp. Duggee explains that many years ago, when rubbed, it could grant three magical wishes.

videos.title: The List Badge
videos.overview: Duggee has lost the list he made for the Squirrel's activities for the day at Squirrel Club. After a quick lesson on what a list is, they are happy to help Duggee recreate his.

videos.title: The Music Video Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are having fun playing a song they made, but they wish that they could see themselves perform. Duggee has a great suggestion, and they learn how to be creative.

videos.title: The Exercise Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels set off on a warm-up run together. The Squirrels are feeling sleepy, but they are told that a bit of exercise will wake them up.

videos.title: The Dos and Don'ts Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are causing a bit too much mess in the clubhouse, so Duggee explains that they need to think more carefully about what they are doing.

videos.title: The Nature Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels can learn more about nature and wildlife if they follow five easy steps: watch carefully, stay at a distance, don’t interfere, be patient and alert, and stay quiet.

videos.title: The Recipe Badge
videos.overview: The hungry Squirrels turn to Duggee when they aren't sure what to eat. Fortunately, he has his cookbook The Clubhouse Kitchen: Tasty Bites for Hungry Squirrels.

videos.title: The Imagination Badge
videos.overview: When the Squirrels tell Duggee that they have nothing left to play with, he encourages them to use their imagination.

videos.title: The Carrot Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee’s crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

videos.title: The Face Painting Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can’t find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

videos.title: The Transport Badge
videos.overview: When Duggee’s old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they’re on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri’s front door. Is he delighted to get his old hat back? Very. What a journey!

videos.title: The Talent Badge
videos.overview: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it’s King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that ‘finding their talents’ means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

videos.title: The Mime Badge
videos.overview: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don’t understand what he’s doing and think it’s funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming.  They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

videos.title: The Why Badge
videos.overview: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them ‘why’ is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

videos.title: The Sibling Badge
videos.overview: It’s news time at the Clubhouse, and the Squirrels share their exciting news of the week with each other. Happy got a new bath sponge, Norrie is growing a sunflower and Roly, after thinking hard if he’s got any news at all, remembers he’s getting a new brother or sister. The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

videos.title: The Monster Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels are playing outside, when out of a bush jumps the cutest creature they ever did see. They think it is simply adorable and tell it so… with startling results. The creature bursts into tears! The creature, whose name is Plinky, tells them her whole family are monsters, and that’s what she’s supposed to be, but she just cannot get the hang of it. The Squirrels are keen to help Plinky get in touch with her scary side. Fortunately, Duggee has his monster badge.

videos.title: The Diary Badge
videos.overview: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It’s Duggee’s diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren’t sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

videos.title: The Metal Detector Badge
videos.overview: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

videos.title: The Cheerleading Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels find Duggee’s cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. It's time to practise: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. There’s a big match ahead...

videos.title: The Waiting Badge
videos.overview: When they’re accidentally locked in a shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope very well. Does Duggee?

videos.title: The Good Choices Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels haven’t been making good choices round the messy clubhouse. With Duggee’s help, they start to get it right - but not before sending Roly’s imagination into overdrive!

videos.title: The Shopping Badge
videos.overview: Duggee loves to shop locally, so the big shop is a big deal for him. He’s overexcited and wants two of everything. The Squirrels have to remind him that they only popped in for milk!

videos.title: The Love Badge
videos.overview: When Duggee gets a card from someone he loves, the Squirrels ask if he still loves them. In a show-stopping song, Delivery Chipmunk proves the answer is a resounding yes.

videos.title: The Rollercoaster Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster ever. From a sweet song to spinning through a helix and getting the full g-force, it’s a ride Duggee’s going to remember!

videos.title: The World Record Badge
videos.overview: The Squirrels want to get a world record, but in what? Duggee is too busy to help. Luckily, Norrie has a record-breaking idea...

videos.title: The In Charge Badge
videos.overview: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

videos.title: The Laughter Badge
videos.overview: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggee’s infectious laughter, once everyone starts, it’s so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Does anyone remember?

videos.title: The Midnight Badge
videos.overview: Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?
